body:
A human turns the selected elements into a note and sends it with their next message to the design agent.

### Do

- With elements selected (task:ab14673c99699681), the human can add a note: those element IDs plus text.
- The next message sent from the panel on the Design page carries the notes added since the last one, through task:a9c5cc32e0283494.
- A sent note is cleared from the page; it is not kept on the design.
- Nothing changes on the Strategy page's panel.

Ask the human how a note's text is entered, and how waiting notes are shown and removed before sending.

### Acceptance

- Tests: a note holds the selected IDs and its text, sending a message posts its notes, and the notes are cleared after sending.
- One end-to-end check: a human selects a button, adds a note, sends a message, and the agent's reply names that button.
- Update the README.

### Left out

Notes that stay on a design, and resolving notes.
title: notes: add a note from the panel
